macro.title: CMLS names Cameron Kinzer director of advocacy
macro.what: New role focuses on federal, state, and local engagement tied to AI, privacy, antitrust and compensation debates
macro.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
macro.market: Lower rates support demand/valuations; higher rates pressure builders/REITs and slow transactions.

macro.title: This Week’s Inflation Data Could Be Deciding Factor in Whether the Fed Hikes Rates
macro.what: Here’s our weekly economic update for the week of September 8
macro.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
macro.market: Lower rates support demand/valuations; higher rates pressure builders/REITs and slow transactions.

housing.title: It’s Now The Strongest Buyer’s Market on Record, Driven by the Sun Belt
housing.what: Sellers outnumbered buyers by 58% in August, the biggest gap in our records, driven by a surge in listings and stagnant demand
housing.why: Inventory and velocity drive pricing power and volume.
housing.market: Rising inventory/DOM tilts to buyers; tight supply supports prices.

housing.title: Dueling lawsuits contest new San Francisco Family Zoning rules
housing.what: Early filings pair the rezoning with AB 1287 and SB 423, while CEQA and pro-housing suits move forward
housing.why: Relevant development for housing and markets.
housing.market: Watch second-order effects across builders, lenders, and REITs.

housing.title: High Costs Sideline Some Would-Be Homebuyers, Handing Upper Hand to Those Who Stay in the Market
housing.what: Redfin agents say pricing realistically from the start is the key to finding a buyer; 21% of home sellers are dropping their price
housing.why: Price trend signals wealth effects and buyer/seller power.
housing.market: Firm prices help builder margins; softness hits comps and sentiment.

housing.title: Parents follow their kids to the South in ‘baby chaser’ boom
housing.what: Affordability also plays a role, providing younger buyers with more accessible homeownership
housing.why: Rent moves feed shelter inflation and multifamily fundamentals.
housing.market: Rising rents help MF REITs; falling rents ease inflation but pressure NOI.

housing.title: Housing Market Spotlight: When housing market signals don’t agree
housing.what: Comparing new listings, pending sales and active inventory reveals when local housing market signals agree and when a divergence is worth a closer look
housing.why: Inventory and velocity drive pricing power and volume.
housing.market: Rising inventory/DOM tilts to buyers; tight supply supports prices.

housing.title: National Home Corp. targets 18% gross margin with pace focus
housing.what: CEO Michael Bergman said July results hit plan with 70 closings and 93 starts
housing.why: Supply pipeline sets future inventory and construction activity.
housing.market: Stronger pipeline aids suppliers; oversupply later can weigh on pricing.

housing.title: Housing Supply Hits 6-Year High As New Listings Jump, Giving Buyers Bargaining Power
housing.why: Inventory and velocity drive pricing power and volume.
housing.market: Rising inventory/DOM tilts to buyers; tight supply supports prices.

housing.title: Coming Soon in San Juan Capistrano: A $7.5 Million Estate With a Wine Cellar, Movie Theater and Resort-Style Backyard
housing.what: In this edition of Coming Soon–a series from Redfin News that explores new listings that house hunters can find early only on Redfin.com–we’re heading to Southern California to tour a $7.5 million estate with a movie theater and 900-bottle wine cellar
housing.why: Inventory and velocity drive pricing power and volume.
housing.market: Rising inventory/DOM tilts to buyers; tight supply supports prices.

housing.title: History Shows That Adjustable-Rate Mortgages Pay Off For Homebuyers Most of the Time
housing.what: Over the past half-century, homebuyers would have saved money by choosing an ARM about 70% of the time, thanks to later opportunities to refinance into a lower 30-year fixed rate
housing.why: Rates & inflation shape discount rates and housing affordability.
housing.market: Lower rates support demand/valuations; higher rates pressure builders/REITs and slow transactions.
